repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate computes an absolute difference (lines 4-7) before checking the condition, whereas the IR requires the signed difference ($t2 - $t1) to be checked directly. This causes the action to fire when the temperature dropped by 3 degrees, while the IR only fires when it rose by 3 degrees (t2 >= t1 + 3). Evidence F2 shows the JoI emitted an action when the IR did not.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute value calculation and the nested if statement. The script now directly computes the signed difference and checks if it is greater than or equal to 3, matching the IR's logic exactly.
